##### Project general facts

Saria is a signature project offering a range of luxurious residences from apartments to duplexes and penthouses in a marvelous tower nestled right on the water's edge. This urban sanctuary with a tropical resort-inspired ambience offers majestic views and the calming sea, where marina living ascends to a whole new level. Amidst the bustle of daily life, residents find solace and serenity, evoking the eternal bliss of an endless vacation at a secluded tropical haven.

The development offers a meticulously curated selection of world-class facilities including a state-of-the-art gymnasium, an infinity swimming pool, a spa and sauna, and a cinema room for countless experiences for the body and mind to unwind. Residents can enjoy spectacular views from the podium level, providing an ideal backdrop for weekend barbecues, social occasions, or formal soirees. Every amenity has been thoughtfully designed to create unforgettable experiences and a lifestyle of indulgent comfort.

Each residence features grand interiors with a melange of textured surfaces, stone and metal accents, tiles, wood finishes, and textured glass that create an inviting melody of sophisticated elegance. The carefully crafted design offers sweeping views from every residence, enhanced by soaring floor-to-ceiling windows and wraparound balconies that frame breathtaking vistas of the tranquil sea, the stunning Marina, the Burj, and the iconic Dubai city skyline. A mix of high-quality stone, wood, fabric, and metal elements enhances both visual and tactile experiences, emphasizing tranquillity and the intimacy of one's personal space.

##### Location description and benefits

This prestigious development is situated in Dubai Maritime City, a unique and innovative community located in the heart of Dubai that offers a comprehensive range of maritime services and infrastructure. The community is designed to create a conducive environment for businesses and professionals in the maritime sector, featuring state-of-the-art shipyards, dry docks, and repair facilities. The area offers specialized zones for maritime businesses, marine equipment providers, and maritime education and training institutions.

The district is strategically located, offering convenient access to major transportation hubs and business districts throughout Dubai. The community benefits from its proximity to Dubai's ports, connecting it to global trade routes and facilitating seamless movement of goods and services. The strategic location ensures efficient logistics and easy connectivity for businesses and residents alike.

The neighborhood's unique maritime character creates a distinctive and vibrant atmosphere that sets it apart from other areas of Dubai. The community's innovative design and comprehensive infrastructure make it an ideal destination for those seeking a dynamic and well-connected living environment. This distinguished location represents the perfect combination of maritime heritage, strategic connectivity, and modern urban living, offering an unmatched lifestyle in one of Dubai's most distinctive communities.
